entity.name: Himanshu Verma
entity.description: Open-source infrastructure engineer based in India. I'm a maintainer and Technical Committee member of CNCF Kepler, where I own GPU support, the Helm manifests, e2e tests and CI. I also contribute to Apache HugeGraph (95 merged PRs across Apache repos), where I wrote the distributed-mode Helm chart and fixed bugs in its consensus, storage and auth layers. I'm independent: no company pays me for this work.

projects.name: Kepler (CNCF)
projects.description: Kubernetes-based Efficient Power Level Exporter. Measures energy use at node, pod, container, VM and process level and exports it as Prometheus metrics. I'm a maintainer and TC member (voted in: https://github.com/sustainable-computing-io/kepler/pull/2550) and work on GPU (NVIDIA NVML) support, Helm manifests, e2e tests, CI and releases.

projects.name: Apache HugeGraph
projects.description: Distributed graph database under the Apache Software Foundation. I contribute to its distributed mode: the Kubernetes Helm chart, PD and Store recovery, readiness checks and auth.
